official_question: Using DESeq2 for differential expression analysis, how many genes show significant differential expression (adjusted p-value < 0.05, absolute log2 fold change > 0.5, baseMean > 10) in the CBD/cisplatin combination treatment compared to DMSO control?

official_ideal.direction_convention: positive log2 fold change means higher expression in Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50 than DMSO

checker_grounding_rule: Use the immutable official BixBench v1.5 ideal and contrast definition for the aggregate scientific truth. Candidate-authored labels or counts are not truth. Independently validate candidate tables for six-sample membership, orientation, threshold logic, internal row/count consistency, and explicit uncertainty; accept equivalent deterministic DESeq2 layouts and naming.
